data.action: 摘下的眼镜放在桌上，双手抓住视角衣袖，抬眼露出惊讶而害羞的浅笑。
data.camera: medium close-up, eye level, sleeve in foreground
data.description: 黄昏的社团活动室里，希耶尔的眼镜已经折好放在书桌上。少了镜片的遮挡，她对上你近在眼前的目光，蓝色眼眸里浮起惊讶，耳根一点点变红。她穿着整齐的藏青校服外套和灰色百褶裙，双手轻轻攥住你递来的衣袖，想要说些什么，又先露出难为情的浅笑。
data.location: 夕阳斜照的无人社团活动室书桌旁
data.promptProse: Ciel faces her nearby companion in the evening clubroom, both hands lightly gripping the sleeve offered toward her. Without glasses, her blue eyes show surprise before a small embarrassed smile appears; her navy blazer, red tie and grey skirt stay orderly. Keep the sleeve in the close foreground and folded glasses on the desk behind. Soft sunset enters from the side, warming her ear and casting a restrained sleeve shadow across her hands.
data.title: 希耶尔 · 摘下眼镜的慌乱娇羞
